The '''amphibious wolf''' was a type of [[Wolf/Legends|wolf]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to<ref name="RoBW" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Shaymore system/Legends|Shaymore system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shaymore]]. During a joint effort by the native [[Sessehshellah]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to expel a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[hydrocarbon]] [[Mining/Legends|extraction]] operation from Shaymore, a pack of amphibious wolves attacked a Rebel-Sessehshellah [[Task force/Legends|taskforce]] crossing a stretch of [[Swamp/Legends|marshes]] to [[Sabotage of an Imperial power station|sabotage]] an [[Imperial power station]]. The Sessehshellah and the Rebels presented an allied defense, and were successful in driving away the wolves.<ref name="RoBW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The amphibious wolf appeared in "[[Rings of Bright Water]]", an adventure written by [[Ken Rolston]] and collected in the [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|first edition]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in [[1987]].<ref name="RoBW" />
